description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Colombo District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement of local authority elections, including the announcement of a new election date (25th April 2023) and listing the affected local authorities. It falls under the Elections category as it concerns electoral processes, scheduling changes, and is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
